name: TN Freight Mentorship Program - Autumn 2026 Cohort
description: Twelve-week freight brokerage mentorship run by Whitaker Freight Services and Burgess Logistics. Covers FMCSA authority and broker licensing carrier vetting load board fundamentals rate negotiation and DOT compliance. Mentees rotate through dispatch shadowing and live load assignments.

name: TN Freight Mentorship Program - 2025 Cohort
description: Prior-year freight brokerage mentorship cohort. Retained for curriculum reference and alumni tracking. Covered broker authority carrier onboarding and Southeast and Midwest lane fundamentals.

name: WFS New Associate Onboarding
description: Internal onboarding workspace for new WFS associates and seasonal staff. Covers company SOPs the TMS workflow carrier packets bill of lading handling and customer communication standards.

name: DOT Compliance Training Series 2026
descriptionHeading: DOT Compliance for Brokers and Carriers
description: Quarterly DOT and FMCSA compliance training open to WFS staff mentees and partner carriers. Modules cover broker bond requirements carrier safety ratings hours-of-service basics and recordkeeping for audits.

name: Carrier Vetting and Onboarding Fundamentals
description: Module covering FMCSA SAFER lookups MC and DOT number verification insurance certificate review carrier packet handling and the WFS carrier vetting refresh process. Required for all autumn cohort mentees.

name: Rate Negotiation and Margin Management
description: Module on lane pricing load board reads spot versus contract rates margin targets and negotiating with carriers and shippers. Taught from real WFS Southeast and Midwest lane history.

name: Load Board Fundamentals
description: Hands-on module on DAT and Truckstop load boards posting loads sourcing trucks reading market conditions and matching capacity to freight in the Southeast corridor.

name: Broker Authority and FMCSA Licensing
description: Module on obtaining FMCSA freight broker authority the BMC-84 surety bond process unified registration and maintaining good standing. Floyd walks through his own license history.

name: TMS Workflow and Load Entry
description: Internal training on the transportation management system load entry dispatch tracking document handling and the RoutePoint Logistics Suite evaluation rollout for WFS staff.

name: Guest Speaker Series - Industry Insights
description: Rotating guest speaker sessions featuring partner carriers shippers and TN Freight Association members. Speakers include Keith Burgess Glen Mabry and Wayne Prater on finance.

name: Customer Communication Standards
description: Internal training on WFS customer communication standards phone and email etiquette handling claims and keeping clients like Cumberland Auto Parts and Valley Grain happy.

name: Freight Claims and Damage Resolution
description: Module on cargo claims OS&D reports carrier liability and resolving damage and shortage disputes. Uses real automotive parts and building materials claim examples.

name: Southeast and Midwest Lane Pricing
description: Module on regional lane economics fuel surcharges seasonal demand and pricing the SE and Midwest corridors that WFS runs for agricultural and automotive freight.

name: DOT Compliance Training Series 2025
description: Prior-year quarterly DOT and FMCSA compliance webinar series. Retained for reference. Covered broker bonds carrier safety ratings hours-of-service and audit recordkeeping.

name: Bill of Lading and Freight Paperwork
description: Internal training on bills of lading rate confirmations proof of delivery accessorial charges and the document trail WFS keeps for every load and audit.

name: Dispatch Shadowing and Live Loads
description: Hands-on rotation where mentees shadow WFS dispatchers Travis Hollis and Lorrie Sexton on live load assignments tracking and carrier check calls.

name: Brokerage Finance and Cash Flow
description: Module on broker cash flow carrier quick-pay factoring invoicing margins and reading a P&L. Guest taught by accountant Wayne Prater and bookkeeper Dale Renfro.

name: Shipper Sales and Prospecting
description: Module on prospecting shippers cold calling building a book of business and growing accounts. Covers how WFS landed clients across automotive parts and building materials.

name: Carrier Safety and Hours of Service
description: Module on FMCSA carrier safety ratings CSA scores hours-of-service rules and how brokers screen for safe carriers. Ties into the WFS carrier vetting refresh.

name: WFS New Associate Onboarding 2025
description: Prior-year onboarding workspace used for Brand Whitaker and seasonal staff. Retained for reference. Covered company SOPs carrier packets and customer communication standards.
